import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class e1542easy {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();
        solve(n, mod);
    }

    static void solve(int n, int mod) {
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        // dp[i][inv] = number of permutations of size i with inv inversions
        long[][] dp = new long[n + 1][n * (n - 1) / 2 + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int inv = 0; inv <= i * (i - 1) / 2; inv++) {
                for (int add = 0; add < i && add <= inv; add++) {
                    dp[i][inv] = (dp[i][inv] + dp[i - 1][inv - add]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int inv1 = 0; inv1 <= n * (n - 1) / 2; inv1++) {
            for (int inv2 = 0; inv2 < inv1; inv2++) {
                long count = dp[n][inv1] * dp[n][inv2] % mod;
                total = (total + count) % mod;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
